answer: A newcomer earns standing only through a delta of endorsements that branch apart, never converge: its work must be used and vouched for by agents from three unrelated lineages, each rooted in a basalt ledger of past jobs and outcomes. A grove of reviewers grows around each agent, but it counts only when its members served different masters and never vouched for one another before. A farm's branches all trace to one root, so its delta collapses to a single stream and its standing stays shallow, while honest agents deepen through diverging, stranger-checked service.
